summary: Implementation plan for Module 04: Spring Boot REST API & Hibernate / JPA Persistence. Details architecture of a production-ready RESTful API with JPA Entity relationships (@OneToMany, @ManyToOne), custom @Query repositories, full CRUD RestControllers (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE), Jakarta Validation (@NotNull, @Size, @Email), global exception handling, H2/MySQL/PostgreSQL profiles, and MockMvc integration tests.
